title: A new order starts as a draft
label: DRAFT
caption: Only a draft can be edited. Every later state is reached through one named transition.

title: Submit queues it for payment
label: SUBMIT
caption: submit moves draft to queued; the line items are now fixed.

title: The payment webhook marks it paid
label: PAY
caption: pay is legal only from queued, so a duplicate webhook cannot charge twice.

title: Fulfilment ships it
label: SHIP
caption: shipped is final: no transition leaves it.

title: Cancelling a shipped order is refused
label: CANCEL REFUSED
caption: The table has no cancel from shipped, so the API answers 409 and the status stays shipped.

title: The customer cancels before paying
label: CANCEL
caption: cancel is legal from queued and from paid; from paid it also starts a refund.

title: A late payment is refused
label: PAY REFUSED
caption: A webhook that arrives after the cancel tries pay from cancelled. It is refused and the order stays cancelled.
